export_info.description: Read-only export of every implemented Wanderer card, plus the class-agnostic neutral cards in cards/neutral/ (flagged pool_class = neutral) - the three in the belongings pool, and Endure, which no pool offers. card_text is the rules text a real CardView shows outside a fight (deck view / reward screen): no stance, 0 Toll, no conditional highlighted; an HP price is shown on the face's separate HP line (face_hp_line), not in the text. Numbers that move in battle are listed under dynamic_values with their rule and this default.
export_info.generated: 2026-10-04, from the live data at 67d4637 plus Blood Advance, Second Swing, Garnish, Claw Back and Gnaw
generated_from: res://battle/card_view.tscn (face text, type label, HP line, rules size)
export_info.rarity: CardData.rarity: COMMON, UNCOMMON, RARE or ULTRA_RARE (no card is Ultra Rare yet). A pool decides whether a card can drop; rarity only how often among the ones that can. RewardPool.weights is empty in both pools (every entry weight 1.0).
export_info.keeper: The Keeper (field/keeper.tscn) now offers keepsakes, not cards, so no card is in a Keeper pool and in_keeper_pool is gone.
export_info.rules_font_px: The size the card's rules text fits at: the first of 15, 14, 13, 12 px that fits; no card overflows 12.
export_info.upgrades: No upgrade system exists in the current project (CardData has no upgrade fields); upgrade_data is null on every card.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Energy
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Per-turn resource that pays a card's cost; 3 per turn.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Toll
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Gained when you lose HP to your own cards. Carries between fights; up to 5 carries to the next floor. Self-inflicted losses only (self-damage, status ticks, stance prices), never enemy hits. Spent by Reckoning, Debt Forgiven, Come Due, Leverage and Second Swing (optionally, to repeat its hit); spending it brings a Sentence a turn closer.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Grace
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: After enemy hits get through your Block, damage you deal on your next turn wins HP back, up to the largest hit. Wanderer passive; lost at the end of that turn. Self-damage never opens it.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Critical
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: At or below 30% of your max HP. (CharacterData.critical_hp_fraction 0.3.) Checked live when an effect resolves.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Drain
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Heal for the HP the damage takes from enemies, up to the Drain's number if it has one. Ransom's turn and The Return's trigger Drain. Claw Back's hit Drains too, and Gnaw's once Toll has been spent this turn: an Attack's own blow, so its bonuses are in the heal, Ransom's half comes on top, and it heals only what Grace doesn't reclaim.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Spent
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Removed for the rest of this fight once played. Back in the deck next fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Block
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Absorbs damage before HP; resets at the start of your turn. Last Resort prevents gaining it.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Self-damage
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Bypasses block and absorb, makes Toll, opens no Grace, can kill (Down Payment's and Blood Advance's never take you below 1).

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Stance
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: One stance type at a time, for the rest of the fight. Another copy of the held stance adds a stack; a different stance replaces it at 1. Played stance cards leave the deck's rotation for the fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Power
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Applies a lasting status for the fight; coexists with the stance and other powers. Played power cards leave the deck's rotation for the fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Attack bonus
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Flat extra damage from the stance (x stacks) and a keepsake's status (Keen), paid once per Attack card on its first damage effect - Reckoning included. Second Swing's repeated hit takes the stance's bonus again, but not Keen's.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Marks (Come Due)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: A status on an enemy that adds damage to your next N Attacks against it, once per card per enemy, spending a charge each - and again on a repeated hit (Second Swing), spending another charge while one is left.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Cost changes
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Leverage: the next card costing at least 1 Energy costs 2 less; the House Key's free card is the same kind of next-card discount; 0-cost cards pass both by. Collateral: the next card costing 2 or more costs 5 HP (paid like self-damage) instead of Energy. Each is spent by the card it changes.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Countdown (Sentence)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: A status on an enemy that deals its damage when the turns run out; spending Toll takes a turn off.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Denied (enemy)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Deny's status: the enemy's next move is skipped - lost, not delayed; its pattern advances and the turn still counts, and its statuses still tick. Removed by that turn; doesn't stack, so a Denied enemy can't be targeted by another Deny. Its intent keeps its number, struck through.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Braced (enemy)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Brace's debuff: the enemy's next Attack deals 50% less, every hit; gone once that Attack resolves.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Garnished (enemy)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Garnish's debuff: the enemy's next Attack deals 5 less in all, not per hit - its hits soak the 5 in order, none below 0 (Tail Lash 4×3 lands 0, 3, 4). After Braced's 50%, before Block. Copies add up (two: 10 less). Gone once that Attack resolves; a non-attack move, a Denied or interrupted Attack leave it standing.

cards.name: Second Swing
cards.card_text:
Deal 6 damage.
Spend 6 Toll to repeat.
cards.card_text_template:
Deal {damage} damage.
Spend 6 Toll to repeat.

effects.plain_english: Deal 6 damage to the target. Then, if the target is still alive and you hold 6 or more Toll, spend 6 Toll and deal 6 damage to it again (CardEffect.repeat_toll_cost 6). With less than 6, or once the first hit has killed, nothing more happens and nothing is spent. Never blocks the play. The second hit is a hit of the same card, not a second play: per-card triggers (Goaded, a Ransom Drain, Sentence's hurry) count the card once.

dynamic_values.rule: Each hit adds the ongoing attack bonus - the held stance's bonus x stacks (Self-Eater +3; Last Resort +6 while Critical) - so under Self-Eater both hits deal 9. Keen's +3 (one Attack) goes to the first hit only. A Come Due mark's +4 goes to each hit, spending a charge per hit; with one charge left the first hit takes it and the repeat lands bare. Self-Eater's 2 HP per stack is paid once for the card, before the first hit, and the Toll it makes counts toward the 6. The face shows one hit's number.

In order: House Key's free card (a keepsake), then Leverage's 2 off (never below 0) - both land on and are spent by the next card costing at least 1 Energy, so a 0-cost card leaves them waiting - then Collateral on what's left: a card still costing 2 or more costs 5 HP instead of Energy.
